# bit Tecnologies

> An ecosystem of apps distributed through bit Hub. Android builds are available now; Windows is in development and Linux is planned.

## Products

- [bit Hub](https://bit-tecnologies.vercel.app/bit-hub/): The entry point of the ecosystem: an Android app that installs and updates bit apps from GitHub Releases. A Windows version is in development.
- [bit Delta](https://bit-tecnologies.vercel.app/bit-delta/): Pedometer, activity, and health tracking app.
- [bit Record](https://bit-tecnologies.vercel.app/bit-record/): A simple, minimalist screen recorder.
- [bit Together](https://bit-tecnologies.vercel.app/bit-together/): A messenger with end-to-end encryption (Flutter), currently in development.
- [bit Launcher](https://bit-tecnologies.vercel.app/bit-launcher/): An Android launcher with a clean interface, currently in development.

## Company

- [About bit Tecnologies](https://bit-tecnologies.vercel.app/about/): Mission, principles, and the team behind the ecosystem.
- [Privacy Policy](https://bit-tecnologies.vercel.app/privacy/): What data the website, bit Hub and bit Delta process.

## Source

- [GitHub — bit Tecnologies](https://github.com/bit-Tecnologies): Public repositories for bit Hub, bit Delta and this site. Other repositories are private.
